name: gemm_bias_relu
summary: C = relu(A B + bias) with A M x K, B K x N, bias N broadcast over rows, all f32 row-major
provenance: authored for OpenAccel Lab (Apache-2.0); the fused linear+ReLU epilogue of a dense layer

C.why: A[i,:]B[:,j] + bias[j] is a length-(K+1) dot product (the bias times 1), so in any order, fused or not, |err| <= gamma(K+1)*(sum_k |A[i][k] B[k][j]| + |bias[j]|) (Higham Thm 3.1/3.5); relu is 1-Lipschitz and exact, so the bound carries through it. reference.py passes that sum as scale. WolframLanguageEvaluator: g[n_]:=n 2^-24/(1-n 2^-24); N[g[73],6] -> 4.35116*10^-6, N[g[20],6] -> 1.19209*10^-6
